name: Wellring
description: Rings that crowd together as they go in, so the middle reads as deeper than the edge.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 8%, #000 8% 13%, transparent 13%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 19%, #000 19% 25%, transparent 25%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 32%, #000 32% 39%, transparent 39%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 8%, #000 8% 13%, transparent 13%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 19%, #000 19% 25%, transparent 25%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 32%, #000 32% 39%, transparent 39%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
